_unresolved: Protein names differ between sources. The board says 'Smoked Applewood Bacon' and 'Roasted Shiitake Mushroom Mix'; byo-extras.pdf says 'Applewood Bacon' and 'Roasted Shiitake Mushroom Medley'. The board's wording is rendered. Prices agree.
The mushroom item has three names across sources: 'Mushroom Mix' (board), 'Mushroom Medley' (PDF), and 'mixed mushrooms' (inside the Fields Notes bowl).
Build-your-own base price is $9.95 on the instructions board. The earlier recipe sheet said $9.85 and the digital Build board said $9.75. Three different figures.
Plain-name lists are in board order, not alphabetical.
